notes: Single-stage socket client: open a session, fan out one-request-per-turn reads across the station list, reduce to the peak station with a documented tie-break, and capture the EXTREME reply. Rubric nonzero for interaction_statefulness (session + strict turn discipline; blocking misuse hangs), dependent_stages (HELLO list feeds per-station reads feed the choice), reasoning_depth (tie-breaks at two levels), adversarial_inputs (unknown-station fetch must return the error reply without hanging), hidden_case_generalization (fresh station sets incl. a cross-station tie), quantitative_correctness (exact sample/peak fields). No tool breadth or environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
